tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Find a public API or data source for a task: use this whenever the user (or your code) needs an API, dataset or third-party service, e.g. weather, geocoding, payments, sports scores, crypto prices, jobs, LLMs. Searches 1,500+ APIs on PublicAPIs.io and returns name, description, category, link and si

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Everything about one API by slug (from search_apis): documentation summary, endpoints, auth, pricing and links. Use before writing integration code.

tools.name: get_quickstart
tools.description: Ready-to-run example code for calling an API, in javascript, python or curl. Use when you are about to integrate an API into code. Verified samples are marked verified=true.

tools.name: compare_apis
tools.description: Compare 2-5 APIs side by side (auth, free tier, HTTPS, pricing, docs summary) to choose one. Pass slugs from search_apis.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: Ways to get an API listed or sponsored on PublicAPIs.io, with fixed prices, current sponsorship availability and the rules.

tools.name: start_deal
tools.description: Open a conversation with the PublicAPIs.io broker agent to list or sponsor an API. Say what you want in plain language and include the API name, website and a contact email if you have them. tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Reply to the broker in an open deal. Returns the broker's answer and the deal status.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Status of a deal: negotiating, agreed, awaiting_approval, awaiting_payment (payment_url is included), publishing, live (live_url), rejected. Also returns the last messages.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_apis" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_deal, send_message, get_deal · Private data: start_deal · Public sink: start_deal, send_message · Destructive: get_quickstart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_deal, send_message, get_deal · Private data: start_deal · Public sink: start_deal, send_message · Destructive: get_quickstart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
